preferences.name: tags
preferences.title: Tags
preferences.description: Comma separated list indicating what service and/or custom tags, if any, should be used to filter the list of monitors.

preferences.name: default-filter
preferences.title: Default Filter
preferences.description: Extra Datadog search filter always applied (e.g. 'priority:P1', 'assignee.handle:@me').

preferences.name: claude-workspace-cwd
preferences.title: Claude Workspace Directory
preferences.description: Working directory opened in cmux when launching a Claude Code session from a case. Defaults to your home directory.

preferences.name: api-key
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: Datadog API Key (only used when Authentication is 'API & App Keys')

preferences.name: app-key
preferences.title: App Key
preferences.description: Datadog Application Key (only used when Authentication is 'API & App Keys')

preferences.name: auth-command
preferences.title: Auth Command
preferences.description: Shell command that prints KEY=VALUE lines on stdout (DD_API_KEY, DD_APP_KEY, and optionally DD_SITE). Used when Authentication is 'Command Line'.

preferences.name: domain
preferences.title: Domain
preferences.description: Datadog web UI domain (e.g. app.datadoghq.com, us3.datadoghq.com, app.datadoghq.eu). If it starts with 'app.', the leading 'app.' is stripped to produce the API site; otherwise the domain is used as-is. Optional when the auth command outputs a DD_SITE line, or when the legacy Server preference is set.

preferences.name: server
preferences.title: Server (legacy)
preferences.description: Legacy Datadog server selector. Kept for backwards compatibility — prefer Domain.
